english_title: Strict Monotonicity of the Integral on a Positive Measure Set
statement_en: If $h>0$ almost everywhere on a measurable set $E$ with positive measure, then $$\int_E h\,d\mu > 0.$$
key_techniques: strict positivity on a positive measure set
decompose into level sets such as $\{h \ge 1/n\}$
callout_body: 在测度为正的可测集合$E$上函数$h>0$几乎处处成立(E上不满足此不等式的集合的测度为0),那么$$\int_E h \,d\mu > 0$$
